ns2:section.sectionText: This section is reserved for those secondary level students registered in the sciences, math, social studies, and history certification programs. NOTE: You are required to take this section (SPED 205, Section B, CRN 53210) which meets during the first five weeks of the term (August 27 to Sept 28). Then you will need to register for SPED 405, Section S2, CRN 35776, which will meet during the final ten weeks of the semester (October 1 to December 7).
